main_measure.name: t of the mean 5-bar excess return (vs the coin's mean 5-bar return) on grid bars with forecast >= 5
main_measure.threshold: confirm: mean > 0 with t >= 2 over >= 30 cases and Spearman > 0; reject: mean < 0 with t <= -2 over >= 30 cases

supporting_check.name: Spearman(forecast, 5-bar excess) on grid bars with forecast > 0

decided_by: The mean excess is positive with t >= 2 over at least 30 cases and the Spearman correlation is above 0.
reading: Grid bars are positions 0, 5, 10, ... of each window with t+5 inside the window. The coin's mean 5-bar return is the mean over all of that coin's grid samples in all windows. The plan's 'fewer than 30 cases' rule is reported as not observable.
